method: Signed optimized Release test host; SDK raw-sample batch path using production ASR config, cached production models, new decoder state per call; one per-variant shape warmup outside timer, three trials, serial model runs.
decision: Investigate a modest model-specific input boost further. No product gain/default change yet.
limitations: Only two independent read-speech clips, not population WER or naturally noisy/spontaneous audio. Derived acoustic controls are correlated and not pooled.
Input transforms/hashes are outside decode timers; no product gain-processing overhead claim.
First reference variant is early in the run. Grouped variants, not paired/interleaved; timings are a screen, not a claimed gain speedup.
Wrong short outputs can decode faster; do not rank the 110M quiet failure as a latency win.
VAD/live streaming behavior is not measured; nonspeech controls are one-second synthetic silence/uniform noise, not real room/keyboard noise.
Gain labels are ceilings; amplification caps peaks at 0.99, and recorded input RMS/peak/hash describe actual samples.
CPU/RSS exclude Core ML helper/accelerator work and do not measure energy or total model RAM.
